title: feat(adr-0045): canvas opens the real unlisted app after materialization + UnpublishedAppBar
body:
## What

v1 objectui slice of [ADR-0045](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1767) — pairs with [cloud#256](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/pull/256) (apply_blueprint materializes) and [framework#1768](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1768) (visibility gate):

- `mapMessages` lifts **`materialized`** from the build envelope into `draftReview`
- **`onBuildMaterialized`** (ChatbotEnhanced): fires once per materialized build — including on conversation reload — so the host flips the canvas
- **LiveCanvas** swaps `?preview=draft` → the **real app URL** when the build materializes: the reload shows live seed rows in every list/kanban; header reads *“Live app — unlisted until published”*
- **UnpublishedAppBar**: amber banner on `hidden: true` apps (*“fully functional, only builders can see it”*) with **Publish = visibility flip** (one `PUT /meta/app/:name` with `hidden: false`); yields to DraftPreviewBar in preview mode
- ConsoleFloatingChatbot routes materialized previews to the real URL

## Tests

plugin-chatbot 67/67 · app-shell 418/418. Browser E2E on the full local stack follows in the verification pass (stage→materialize→banner→publish→launcher).
